description: Prepare a token launch: creates the game (or uses an existing game given by existing_title_id) as a draft with its token address reserved, the same way the dashboard wizard does, and returns three ways to sign it with ANY wallet: (A) sign_url: give it to the user, they open it in the dashboard, connect a wallet and sign; (B) call build_token_launch_tx with your own wallet address to get the transaction and sign it yourself; (C) the local @idosgames/mcp signs it with a key from its settings (send_launch_tx). Whoever signs becomes the token creator and receives the creator income. Nothing is paid and nothing is signed by this call. A new game takes a slot of the publisher's plan (TITLE_LIMIT_REACHED when full). The new game and its '-DEV' copy join this connection. Pass the returned LaunchID to the other launch tools; then poll get_launch_status. Needs the 'token:launch' permission.

banner_url.description: New game only, optional: banner image URL on cloud.idosgames.com.

base_game.description: New game only, optional: starter game module the project is built on.

chain_id.description: Network id from get_launch_options (Solana: 0 mainnet, 103 devnet).

creator_tax_percent.description: EVM: creator tax on every trade, one of the rates from get_launch_options (0 = none). Fixed forever.

existing_title_id.description: Optional: launch the token for this EXISTING game of the connection (it must have no token yet). Omit to create a new game.

first_buy.description: Optional creator's first buy in the pair currency, decimal (e.g. "0.01"). 0 or omitted = none. Not above max_first_buy.

holders_percent.description: Share of the creator income paid to token stakers, 0-100 (0 = no staking). Fixed forever.

idea.description: New game only: what the game is about, a few sentences (also picks the base game and category).

link_only.description: New game only: keep the game off the home page and catalog (only by link).

name.description: New game only: the game name shown to players, up to 50 characters.

pool_tier.description: Solana, optional: pool fee tier (pool_configuration) from get_launch_options.

quote_token.description: EVM, optional: pair currency token address from get_launch_options; omit for the native coin.

reward_percent.description: EVM: share of the creator income to the game's reward pool, 0-100; holders + reward <= 100. Fixed forever.

token_description.description: Optional token description (defaults to the idea).

token_image_url.description: Optional token icon: a URL on cloud.idosgames.com (e.g. from generate_image).

name: prepare_token_launch
title: Prepare a token launch
